$Comment: A Burning Grave Candle, what the Gravekeeper burns to open the Headless Horseman's hard ride (Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Hard.json's EntryCost). Requires opens it once Old Jack counts the player Trusted (Honored with Old Jack's Favor), a rank above the plain Grave Candle's (Regular); a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line, so a player can see what to work towards. This is the discounted price trust earns: Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle_Friendly.json sells the same candle from Regular for more Sweets and Life Essence together, and shares this offer's SortOrder. No purchase limit and no rotation. SortOrder 7 puts it after the two plain Grave Candle offers on the lanterns shelf; the same candle for Life Essence and Fire Essence (Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle_Life_Essence.json) and for ten Grave Candles (Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle_Trade.json) follow at SortOrder 8, behind the same lock. Those four are the candle's only offers. Cost is the price in Hallow Sweets: keep it below ten Grave Candles bought at this shop, or buying candles to trade in beats this offer. Named by the item's own keys.
